original_description: UX Pilot helps users create wireframes, high-fidelity UI screens, and multi-screen app flows from natural-language prompts inside ChatGPT. Single-screen requests start generation in the user's UX Pilot workspace right away and show a live preview widget. Multi-screen flow requests first suggest screens; the user confirms selections in the widget before designs are generated. Users can open results in UX Pilot to continue editing.
summary_ja: 自然言語からワイヤーフレームやUI画面、複数画面のアプリフローを作り、UX Pilotで編集する。
limitations: 単一画面はすぐ生成を開始し、複数画面は選択の確認後に生成すると説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との名称照合は未検証。
